purpose: Describe supported center/scale method outputs on the reference split without selecting or ranking a normalization method.
rules: Only the reference split may be used for method comparison.
The locked holdout split must remain excluded from method comparison and method selection.
Comparison output is descriptive only and must not emit a winner, ranking, acceptance threshold, or Production activation.
A separate versioned method-selection decision remains required before generating governed reference statistics.
The comparison packet must carry the exact reference-split fingerprint and provider provenance.
